agent_explanation: Single body (m=1, r~0.695, e=1) falls under gravity 9.81 with dt~0.0173 and no controller. Energy is ~84 J until just before floor impact (step 55: E=83.86 J, vy=-12.36). At the floor bounce between steps 55 and 56 the post-impact speed magnitude increases from 12.36 to 14.20 (+15%) despite e=1 which should conserve speed magnitude (ignoring small gravity work). This injects ~25 J, pushing total energy to 108.99 J, exceeding the 97.46 J limit (E0*1.1+5). Likely cause is the floor collision response (impulse and/or positional correction with substep splitting -- 8 substeps in the violating step) adding energy instead of conserving it for the perfectly elastic case. Reducing restitution to e=0.8 removes the excess gain, confirming the bounce with e=1 as the source.
